result.instructions: Tools for Kiyoh, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our locations received reviews this year, and what is their average rating?"; "Show me the latest reviews for our Amsterdam shop."; "List the reviews that mention delivery delays for location xx-xxxx-xxxx.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Kiyoh data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run kiyoh_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run kiyoh_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run kiyoh_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. kiyoh_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: kiyoh_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the review locations (shops or branches) of the account, with their location ids and rating statistics. Use this first to find the location_id for kiyoh_list_reviews. Send date_since (yyyy-mm-dd) to list locations with reviews created after that date, or updated_since (yyyy-mm-dd) to list locations updated after that date. With neither, the tool uses date_since 2000-01-01. Publication API: GET /v1/publication/review/locations/latest.

date_since.description: Only locations with reviews created after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

updated_since.description: Only locations updated after this date (yyyy-mm-dd). Use instead of date_since.

tools.name: kiyoh_list_reviews
tools.title: List reviews of a location
tools.description: Get all shop reviews of one location: review text, rating and reviewer details as the Kiyoh Publication API returns them. Get location_id from kiyoh_list_locations. Publication API: GET /v1/publication/review/external?locationId=.

location_id.description: The location id (from kiyoh_list_locations), for example xx-xxxx-xxxx.
